{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue_clean == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (after cleaning): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (sales['status'] == 'completed') &
    (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)
]

# Check number of LOYAL completed orders after removing QA
print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders (excluding QA): {len(loyal_completed_clean)}")

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
